risk_note: RV2 by path (linking, catalog, attribution). POST /v1/shares (createShare, CT-15t; BR-ATTR-10 细则, BR-TEXT-20 细则「分享页文案」, BR-PRICE-06, BR-INV-19): preconditions (10005; Taobao / Pinduoduo binding or filing by the sharer's state 30101 / 30111, blocked binding 30153; identified minor by the BR-ID-26 18th-birthday instant 30413 self_minor); a new pid_scene=share link under the sharer's identity and share slot, converted, with share_materials written in the same transaction (app_id from the link) and rolled back on any conversion failure (30121 / 50303 / 30141), so failures leave no link or material; Taobao answers 50301 not_launched before any conversion (no promo link or token yet; TODO blocked on 规划/09 2_TB §2.5), nothing forged. Product resolution per BR-PROD-05: item_ref raw, else links.raw_item_id of the source link or the sharer's own latest link of the product (fresh within 1800 s by the injected clock), else product_refs, else re-resolve; 30143 only when all fail. images from the union detail (the DTO has no image field yet, so []; TODO), not stored; copy per BR-TEXT-20 (title cleaned, coupon / no-coupon price lines, Pinduoduo 拼单 wording, link line, include_default, closing price-basis line) with no earnings anywhere; est_promo quoted with buy_type=share for the sharer only; poster_url always null (D10-426, TODO blocked on TECH-13 and OSS). Idempotency through the platform idempotency module (PostgreSQL unique keys; same key and body replays the same link). The share page's default material provider reads share_materials by (app_id, link_id), Taobao promo_url fallback kept. Contract: createShare no longer planned and lists 30153 / 30131 as convertLink / openLink do (money round 1); generated files regenerated. No migration.
